title: Show the non-blocking server-communication notice

verify.summary: Transitive dependency TASK-053-T2-FT-003-W5 is blocked by TASK-046-T3-FT-003-W2; TASK-067 cannot be promoted or executed through the blocked outcome path.

evidence_required: FT-003-AC-016 RED: communication failures show no accepted notice; GREEN: each server-communication failure renders «Попытка связи с сервером была не успешна в hh:mm:ss» using client-local failure time for 5-10 seconds in the easiest non-obstructive location, stays non-blocking over usable advertising/fresh retry, and is immediately replaced by a newer notice; decisive comparison: controlled clock and successive failure fixtures measure content, interval, replacement and unchanged interaction/state; artifact: Playwright transcript/screenshots under .tasks/TASK-067-T2-FT-003-W6/.
purpose: Own the timed communication notice presentation independently of transport outcome semantics and the degraded-state matrix.
success_outcome: Operators see a short truthful latest-failure notice while participant advertising/retry remains unobstructed.
anti_goals: Do not implement the complete degraded dependency matrix.
Do not persist notices, add a notification framework or offline delivery.

forbidden_scope: Named degraded-state composition owned by TASK-055-T2-FT-003-W7
stop_conditions: The notice blocks advertising or fresh retry.
Timing/replacement cannot be proved on a controlled client clock.

constraints: Use installed playwright cli and controlled client time.
Use exact accepted Russian text and client-local hh:mm:ss.
Prefer bottom-left only as the easiest non-obstructive location; no design system is added.
invariants: Notice remains visible 5-10 seconds unless replaced by a newer notice.
Notice never blocks advertising or retry.
verification_targets: Advertising and fresh-retry behavior remains unchanged.
